title: FD Interest Rates Compared Across 9 Indian Banks (September 2026)
subtitle: 1, 2, 3 and 5-year rates from each bank's own website, what the gap is worth in rupees, and the day-count traps that cost more than picking the wrong bank
excerpt: One-year FD rates at big Indian banks are nearly identical. At three years the spread passes a full percentage point, and some of the best rates start one day after a round tenure. Rates from nine banks' official pages, checked 29 September 2026.
seoTitle: FD Interest Rates Compared: SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis & More (Sep 2026)
metaDescription: FD rates from SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Kotak, PNB, Bank of Baroda, IDFC FIRST and AU Small Finance Bank compared at 1, 2, 3 and 5 years, with maturity values and senior citizen rates.
author: Muthu

faq.question: Which bank gives the highest FD rate right now?
faq.answer: Among the nine banks checked on 29 September 2026, AU Small Finance Bank paid the most for 3 years (7.40%, or 7.90% for senior citizens) and IDFC FIRST Bank paid the most for 1 and 2 years (6.50% and 7.10%). Rates change often, so confirm on the bank's site before booking.

faq.question: Are FDs in small finance banks safe?
faq.answer: Small finance banks are licensed and regulated by the RBI, and their deposits are insured by DICGC up to ₹5 lakh per depositor per bank, including interest. Keeping your total in any one bank within that limit keeps all of it insured.

faq.question: Why is the rate for 3 years different from 3 years and 1 day?
faq.answer: Banks set rates in tenure buckets, and the boundaries don't always fall on round numbers. At HDFC and ICICI, exactly 3 years earns 6.45% while 3 years and 1 day earns 6.50%. At AU, exactly 12 months earns 6.35% while 12 months and 1 day earns 7.10%.

faq.question: Is FD interest taxable?
faq.answer: Yes. It's added to your income and taxed at your slab rate, and the bank deducts TDS once your FD interest for the year crosses the threshold. In the 30% bracket, a 7.40% FD earns roughly 5.2% after tax.
